load_evidence_validator_source:
def load_records(lines):
    result = []
    for line in lines:
        assert len(line) <= 16 << 20, 'model log line cap'
        if 'SLLM_LOAD_EVIDENCE_MISSING ' in line:
            raise ValueError('rank load evidence capture missing')
        if 'SLLM_LOAD_EVIDENCE ' not in line:
            continue
        payload = line.split('SLLM_LOAD_EVIDENCE ', 1)[1]
        (row, end) = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(payload)
        assert re.fullmatch('(?:\\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m)*', payload[end:].strip()) is not None
        assert row['event'] == 'SLLM_LOAD_EVIDENCE' and type(row['tp_rank']) is int and (0 <= row['tp_rank'] < 8)
        assert row['load_completed'] is True and row['load_error_type'] is None and (row['registered_model_available'] is True) and (row['synchronized'] is True) and (row['phase'] == 'load_boundary_before_profiler_exit_reset')
        assert isinstance(row['device'], str) and re.fullmatch('cuda:[0-7]', row['device']) and (row['device_uuid'] == s['gpu_uuids'][row['tp_rank']]) and (type(row['pid']) is int) and (row['pid'] > 0)
        assert isinstance(row['quant_method_counts'], dict) and any(('compressed_tensors' in k and 'WNA16' in k and (type(v) is int) and (v > 0) for (k, v) in row['quant_method_counts'].items())) and isinstance(row['kernel_backend_counts'], dict)
        assert all((isinstance(k, str) and type(v) is int and (v > 0) for group in ('quant_method_counts', 'kernel_backend_counts') for (k, v) in row[group].items()))
        memory = row['memory']
        keys = ('allocated_bytes', 'reserved_bytes', 'peak_allocated_bytes', 'peak_reserved_bytes', 'driver_free_bytes', 'driver_total_bytes')
        assert all((type(memory[k]) is int and memory[k] >= 0 for k in keys))
        assert 0 <= memory['allocated_bytes'] <= memory['reserved_bytes'] <= memory['peak_reserved_bytes'] and memory['allocated_bytes'] <= memory['peak_allocated_bytes'] <= memory['peak_reserved_bytes'] and (0 < memory['driver_total_bytes']) and (memory['driver_free_bytes'] <= memory['driver_total_bytes'])
        cap = 131072 * (1 << 20)
        assert memory['peak_allocated_bytes'] <= cap and memory['peak_reserved_bytes'] <= cap and (memory['driver_total_bytes'] - memory['driver_free_bytes'] <= cap), 'recorded GPU memory exceeds approved cap'
        storages = row['registered_storages']
        tensors = row['registered_tensors']
        assert isinstance(storages, list) and storages and isinstance(tensors, list) and tensors
        ids = {v['storage_id'] for v in storages}
        assert len(ids) == len(storages) and ids == set(range(len(storages)))
        assert all((type(v['bytes']) is int and v['bytes'] >= 0 and isinstance(v['names'], list) and isinstance(v['device'], str) for v in storages))
        assert row['unique_registered_storage_bytes'] == sum((v['bytes'] for v in storages)) > 0
        for tensor in tensors:
            assert tensor['kind'] in ('parameter', 'buffer') and isinstance(tensor['name'], str) and (tensor['storage_id'] in ids) and (type(tensor['bytes']) is int) and (tensor['bytes'] >= 0) and (type(tensor['storage_offset']) is int) and (tensor['storage_offset'] >= 0)
            assert isinstance(tensor['shape'], list) and all((type(v) is int and v >= 0 for v in tensor['shape'])) and isinstance(tensor['stride'], list) and (len(tensor['stride']) == len(tensor['shape'])) and isinstance(tensor['dtype'], str) and isinstance(tensor['device'], str)
            assert tensor['bytes'] == 0 or not tensor['device'].startswith('meta')
            owner = storages[tensor['storage_id']]
            assert owner['storage_id'] == tensor['storage_id'] and tensor['kind'] + ':' + tensor['name'] in owner['names'] and (owner['device'] == tensor['device'])
        assert any((v['bytes'] > 0 and v['dtype'] in ('torch.int32', 'torch.uint8') and v['device'].startswith('cuda:') for v in tensors))
        assert isinstance(row['empty_g_idx_keys'], list) and isinstance(row['coverage'], str) and ('nonregistered' in row['coverage']) and math.isfinite(row['capture_seconds']) and (row['capture_seconds'] >= 0)
        result.append(row)
    assert len(result) == 8 and {v['tp_rank'] for v in result} == set(range(8)) and (len({v['pid'] for v in result}) == 8) and ({v['device_uuid'] for v in result} == set(s['gpu_uuids'])), 'complete eight-rank load evidence required'
    return sorted(result, key=lambda v: v['tp_rank'])
